_note: Winter Night Market pier (note 14, attractions 5 and 6; note 21). Every number is a placeholder to tune in play. Times are minutes since midnight.

lines.noPermit: The pier keeper holds up a hand. Fishing from the lit pier needs a permit, 1000g for the evening.
lines.closed: The pier closes at 23:00. The lanterns are being taken in.
lines.shut: The pier is only open on the market evenings.
lines.sold: The keeper tears a ticket. The permit is good until the pier closes at 23:00.
lines.floatDone: You have already floated your lantern tonight.
lines.floated: The keeper lights a paper lantern and sets it on the water. May the river be kind to you tonight.
lines.drink: A hot drink, free for the evening. You feel warm again.
lines.drinkDone: You have had your hot drink tonight.
